entities.summary: Raimel Antonio Tapia Linarez is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder for the Sultanes de Monterrey of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies, Toronto Blue Jays, Boston Red Sox, Milwaukee Brewers, and Tampa Bay Rays.
